create_subsample_dataset: create a SubsampleDataset to randomly subsample a fairseq dataset by a specified size ratio
build_subsample_with_shuffle: build a SubsampleDataset with shuffle enabled to randomize batch ordering during training
review_ordered_indices: review the SubsampleDataset ordered_indices method to understand how batches are constructed based on size
test_collater_delegation: test the SubsampleDataset collater method to verify it delegates sample batching to the wrapped dataset
summarize_prefetch: summarize the SubsampleDataset prefetch method that maps indices to the underlying dataset for data loading
